rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 3AA label, but it overstates certainty about ICM location/quality and TE uniformity from this single somewhat blurry image; some described details are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, diminished ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and cycle context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and age-related euploidy to prognosis; minor issues include speculative Bayesian precision and some overinterpretation of limited data.

Mostly aligned on embryo assessment and general counseling, but several recommendations are more speculative or not guideline-standard for this scenario (routine aspirin, thrombophilia workup after a single biochemical pregnancy, ERA, growth hormone/DHEA/testosterone priming).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including contingency scenarios, though some suggested interventions are not strongly evidence-based.
